schema.title: Idempotency-Key

200.description: A retry with the same Idempotency-Key and body: the session the first request created, as it is now, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`. Nothing new starts.

409.description: A conflict, named by `error.code`. `idempotency_conflict`: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request in the last 24 hours.

410.description: `idempotency_session_erased`: the session this Idempotency-Key created was erased; it is not created again until the key expires.

Start ComfyUI without a checkpoint. Called when the owner opens the Images tab.

delete.description: Delete an image and its files, cancelling it first if it is still queued or running.

get.description: Return an image's JSON record, its PNG for ids ending in .png (404 until done), or its edit inputs for .source.png and .mask.png.

post.description: Cancel a queued or running image and wait until a running one stops; finished images are returned as they are.
Queue a masked edit of a finished image and return the queued job before it runs.
Queue a 2x or 4x upscale of a finished image; a repeat for a scale already queued or done returns that job.

get.description: List scheduled jobs, each with its most recent run.

post.description: Create a scheduled job after validating it; its next run is set from the cron schedule.

get.description: The next few run times of a schedule, or why it's invalid.

schema.title: Response Preview Cron Jobs Preview Get

delete.description: Delete a scheduled job and record the deletion in the audit log.

get.description: Return one scheduled job with its 15 most recent runs.

put.description: Replace a scheduled job's settings after validation and recompute its next run.

post.description: Run a job now, outside its schedule (the next scheduled run is unchanged).

get.description: Key metadata only; a key's secret is returned once, by the create response.

post.description: Mints an API key and returns its secret only in this response; a Hub's owner-kind request gets 403.

delete.description: Revokes one key; an unknown or already revoked id returns 404, and the Hub's own key returns 409.

get.description: Disk usage of session workspaces and checkpoints, and of the data volume.

post.description: Write a dated backup of the database, transcripts, and config, wait for it, then prune old backups.
Runs a cleanup pass now, after any pass in progress, and returns what it removed.
Delete the archived images from a preview if its confirmation still matches; a missing or stale one returns 409.
Preview the archived images that retention would delete, with the confirmation to pass to apply.

get.description: Caller's identity, role and capabilities, plus disk and queue usage where the account has it.
The agent profile new sessions get, and the latest change agents saved to the memory library.

put.description: Owner edit of the agent profile from Settings. Commits and pushes like an approved memory write.

get.description: Configured models with their context sizes; one is marked as the default.
Report each model's load state and how long its current warm-up has been running.

post.description: Load the default model if it's asleep. The web app calls this when it opens.
Send a test push notification through ntfy.

get.description: Owner view. Codes themselves are shown only by the create response.

post.description: Mint a single-use pairing code bound to one origin; it is returned only here and expires after its TTL.

delete.description: Expire an unused pairing code now; 404 when no such code is still active.

get.description: The profile icon and the list of icons to choose from.

put.description: Sets the profile icon; the emoji must be one of the listed choices.

get.description: Projects visible to the caller, or an empty list for a read-only demo session.

post.description: Creates a project with an empty workspace or a repo cloned per session; `github` clones use the caller's GitHub sign-in.

get.description: Queue positions of the caller's queued agent sessions, in queue order.
Report whether Remote Control is enabled and each project's state.

post.description: Start a Remote Control server for a project and return once it is ready to pair; Claude Code must already trust the folder.
Stop a project's Remote Control server and its child processes; 404 if none was started.
Open a Claude console window in a project so the user can accept workspace trust; Windows only.

get.description: Return the resource guard's state, the model's status, and the default load-now duration.
One reading for Actions -> Resources (VRAM, RAM, GPU/CPU load, model and guard state). Not polled.

post.description:
pause: hold the GPU for other uses until resumed. resume: end the hold, ignoring the current triggers (the
model stays unloaded until something needs it). load: load the model now and keep it loaded for
duration_seconds. unload: unload it now without holding the queue.

get.description: Owner view. Native pairing codes and runner tokens are never included.

post.description: Create a one-time Mac pairing code, returned only in this response, that expires after its lifetime.

delete.description: Revoke an unused, unexpired pairing code; 404 if no such code is active.

get.description: List each runner's presence, compatibility, pending requests, and whether remote update is supported.

post.description: Long-poll for requests queued to this runner; returns when work arrives or the hold ends.
Report one request's result; accepted is false if it is no longer pending, and 413 for results over 16 MiB.
Ask an online Mac runner to update itself and wait for the outcome; 409 if offline, too old, or failed.

get.description: Full-text search over past sessions. Passages mark matches with \u0002 ... \u0003.

One page of the caller's sessions, newest first. The first page (no `before`) also holds every session that
is active or waits on an approval, whatever its age; `X-Next-Before` names the next older page (#663).

post.description: Starts an agent session and returns before its run finishes.

get.description: Current state of one session, with its queue position and any pending approvals.

patch.description: Renames the conversation; its whitespace is collapsed and the title must be 1 to 120 characters.

put.description: Renames the conversation; its whitespace is collapsed and the title must be 1 to 120 characters.

get.description: Pending approvals for the session, or every approval when `all` is true.

post.description: Approves or denies an approval; `pending` works only when exactly one is waiting, and a decided one returns 409.
Stops an active session and returns once its run has ended; 409 when nothing is active.

get.description: The session's git diff by repository, with its secret-scan result; a removed workspace returns no repositories.
Checkpoints by turn, with flags for whether rewind and fork are allowed here.

post.description: Starts a new session from this checkpoint with a non-blank prompt, and returns before its run finishes.
Rewinds the session to this checkpoint; 409 while it runs, and hosted CLI sessions cannot rewind.

get.description:
Server-sent events: replays persisted events after `after`, then streams live ones.
Ephemeral events (token deltas, queue moves) have `seq: null` and are never replayed.

post.description: Sends a follow-up and returns before the reply finishes; a running session reads it before its next model call.

get.description: Owner-only per-turn context-efficiency metrics for one agent session (#159).

post.description: Starts a new session repeating this one's original prompt, project and taint, optionally on another backend or model; 409 for App tools-only sessions.

get.description: Draft line comments on the session's Changes diff, not yet sent to the agent.

post.description: Saves a draft line comment on the Changes diff; nothing reaches the agent until the drafts are sent.
Send the drafted line comments to the agent as one follow-up message.

delete.description: Removes one draft line comment; 404 if no draft has that id.

post.description: merge | push | discard the session's git branch.
Ask agent to fix: one draft review comment per open secret-scan finding (send them like any draft).
Owner-only: dismiss one secret-scan finding with a reason (audited).
Clears the session's untrusted-source taint and records the clear.

get.description: The session's transcript as plain text.
List proposals and installed skills; returns empty lists with enabled false when the module is off.
List installed skills that are enabled; returns an empty list when the module is off.

delete.description: Delete a proposal and its draft files; 409 if it has been installed.

get.description: Return one proposal, including its body; 404 if no proposal has that id.

post.description: Install a proposal whose content hash matches the reviewed bytes; 409 if the hash is stale, rejected, or fails validation.
Reject a proposal and block its content hash; an installed proposal must be uninstalled first.
Reopen a rejected proposal and lift its content-hash block; it returns to validated or draft.
Queue an advisory hosted review that uses reviewer quota and returns before it runs; 400 if none is configured.
Turn an installed skill off without changing its version or project allowlist.
Turn an installed skill on without changing its version or project allowlist.

get.description: Return the installed skill's current version as an exportable bundle with its content hash.

put.description: Replace the projects an installed skill is allowed in; unknown project names get 400.

post.description: Roll an installed skill back to its previous version; 409 when no older version exists.
Remove an installed skill's files and project allowlist.

get.description: Smart-approval status and the 20 most recent reviews.

put.description: Sets the smart-approval mode; any mode but off needs smart_approvals configured in harness.yaml.

get.description: List saved task templates.

post.description: Create a task template after checking its name, prompt, project, backend, and model.

delete.description: Delete a saved task template.

put.description: Replace a task template's fields after the same checks as create; returns 404 if it does not exist.

get.description: Describe the endpoint's routes, models, features, and GPU state; a disabled endpoint returns 401.
List the models the endpoint serves; 404 while the endpoint is disabled.
